name: Charade Maniacs
source:
In the near future...

Summer break was around the corner. Hiyori Sena, a sophomore in high school, was living a peaceful life. One day, as she was walking home with her childhood friend, a masked figure appeared before them. The two were abducted and taken to a strange world with two moons.

When they awoke, they met nine others in the same predicament. In their confusion, the mysterious figure began to speak.

[i]"Welcome to Arcadia!"
"In this world, if you perform for us, your wildest dreams can come true!"[/i]

In order to find their way home, the group was forced to work together and act in an assortment of scenes from a drama.

They were also made aware that a traitor walked among them... What could be the motive of this traitor? And why are they all being forced to act?

Unable to fully trust anyone, whose hand will she take in the end?

[From [url=http://ideafintl.com/charade-maniacs/]Idea Factory International[/url]]
translation:
在不久的将来…

暑假即将来临。高中二年级学生日和濑名过着平静的生活。有一天，当她和儿时的朋友一起走回家时，一个蒙面人出现在他们面前。两人被绑架，带到了一个有两个月亮的陌生世界。

当他们醒来时，遇到了同样困境的另外九个人。正当他们困惑之际，那神秘人物开口说话了。

[i]“欢迎来到阿卡迪亚！”
“在这个世界上，只要你为我们表演，你最疯狂的梦想就能实现！”[/i]

为了找到回家的路，一行人被迫齐心协力，扮演戏剧中的各种场景。

他们也意识到，有一个叛徒走在他们中间……这个叛徒的动机到底是什么？为什么他们都被迫采取行动？

无法完全信任任何人，她最终会握住谁的手？

[来自[url=http://ideafintl.com/charade-maniacs/]Idea Factory International[/url]]
